---
name: False alarm or missed value
about: Sangop masked something that is not personal data, or did not mask something it should have
labels: detection
---

> **Do NOT paste real personal data or secrets.** Replace every real value with an invented one that has the same *shape* (same length, separators, and checksum validity where you can). If you are unsure whether a value is safe to share, do not share it.

**Which kind** (Aadhaar / PAN / GSTIN / IFSC / phone / UPI / card / e-mail / secret / other), and the label you saw

**Invented example text** (a sentence or two around the value)

**Result you saw** and **result you expected**

**Which rule set was active?** (the `"rules"` value printed by `sangop selftest`)

Known limits are listed in the README; a report that matches one of them is still useful as evidence of how often it happens.
